answer: The saffron counter is kept in timber and ledge shows each reset. Someone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4092 identities would post 3791 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
